text:
We acknowledge your complaint regarding delays in processing a claim related to your companion animal’s travel oversight and the comfort monitoring during transit. Aurelia Skyways records indicate that your file was not completed within the expected sequence, and we regret the distress this caused you and Winston.

To protect your right to recovery, please note that escape in transit requires filing a claim within 59 days; this means you must submit your documentation by the end of that window. Once a claim is accepted, the standard payout for your approved loss is escape in transit at $438; this means the approved reimbursement amount is issued at that level without additional deductions for routine cabin monitoring.

Your petition will be reviewed again immediately by our welfare coordinator, with attention to animal comfort needs and to the cabin team’s documented monitoring notes from the relevant travel segment. If any supporting records were missing, we will request only the minimum items needed to verify the timeline and the care provided, and we will prioritize completion due to the urgency you described.

For continuity, keep your contact details current with your reservation holder, and ensure all documentation is legible. You will receive written confirmation of the review outcome through the channel you used for the initial complaint.

Records Aide  
Companion Animal Travel Desk
